newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy employment rose 0.4 pct in 1996, Prodi says.
newsitem.headline: Italy employment rose 0.4 pct in 1996, Prodi says.

text.p: Prime Minister Romano Prodi said on Friday that employment rose 0.4 percent in 1996, and he expected a clear improvement in 1997.
In a speech to a congress of the Democratic Party of the Left (PDS), the largest force in his coalition, he said his government had made tackling unemployment a priority.
He said now that his government had entered what he called a "second phase" of its work, it would forge ahead with an attack on unemployment.
Unemployment stood at 12.2 percent in October 1996, the last quarterly figures available. -- Rome newsroom +396-678-2501
